name: Cello
description:
Connect Cello to Claude to build and scale your referral, partner, or affiliate programs without leaving the conversation.

For growth and marketing teams: 
Ask which referrers drive the most revenue, identify who to re-engage before they churn, and get recommendations to improve conversion. Pull program metrics and compare them against benchmarks.

For developers and technical teams: 
Confirm your integration status, check whether attribution is working correctly, and validate incoming webhook or API events. Fetch setup documentation in context when you need it.

Key capabilities:
— Live referral program metrics and benchmark data
— Top referrer identification
— Attribution and integration health status
— Actionable recommendations
— On-demand setup and API documentation

Works across Claude.ai, Claude Code, and Cowork. Connect once, query in plain language.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Cello to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Cello to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.cello.so/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Cello MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cello provides these MCP tools: cello_get_events, cello_get_integration_status, cello_get_program_metrics, cello_get_recommendations, cello_get_referrers, cello_get_top_referrers, and cello_search_documentation.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Cello?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Cello in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Cello requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Cello is developed by Cello. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
